scene.description: Direct-frontal BEFORE/AFTER 50/50 horizontal split occupies the middle of the frame. A two-line ALL CAPS headline anchors the top: line 1 BLACK ('TIRED OF YOUR OLD WINDOWS?'), line 2 RED ('GET 40% OFF — LIMITED TIME') — IDENTICAL to V1 and V2. The left panel shows an AI-generated BEFORE — weathered/aged subject (e.g., a worn-out sliding glass door with sun-faded frame and scuffed track, OR a degraded window in a stone-facade or board-and-batten exterior). The right panel shows the AFTER — fresh AI-generated installation in the same opening, with the asset class CLEARLY DIFFERENT from V1 and V2 (sliding-glass door OR window in a different exterior wall context). Same dramatic transformation feel; clearly different asset class. Yellow rectangular BEFORE/AFTER badges sit at panel bottom corners. Google Business Review badge top-right. Compliance fine print at bottom edge. NO person, NO founder.
scene.subject: AI-generated alternate BEFORE/AFTER pair — third style variant. EITHER (a) sliding-glass door BEFORE = sun-faded/scuffed; AFTER = fresh white-frame installation; OR (b) window in a different exterior context — board-and-batten or stone-facade wall instead of stucco. Generic SoCal residential, NOT a recognizable CDW install.
scene.setting: Generic Southern California residential exterior — NOTABLY DIFFERENT exterior wall style from V1 and V2 (e.g., board-and-batten siding, stone facade, OR painted wood lap siding instead of beige stucco). NO recognizable house number, NO readable street sign.
scene.action: Static — image-led; the photo IS the proof.
